Folder.title: Folder
Folder.description: A folder representing a level in the hierarchy (Main Folder, Subfolder, or Unit).

parentId.description: The ID of the parent folder, or null if it's a Level 1 folder.

level.description: The level of the folder (1, 2, or 3).

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns this folder.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the folder was created.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the folder was last modified.

Flashcard.title: Flashcard
Flashcard.description: A flashcard belonging to a unit with SM-2 spaced repetition parameters.

unitId.description: The ID of the unit (Level 3 folder) this card belongs to.

cardName.description: Custom user-defined title for the flashcard.

frontText.description: Text on the front of the card.

backText.description: Text on the back of the card.

frontImageUrl.description: Compressed base64 data URL or URL of the image on the front.

backImageUrl.description: Compressed base64 data URL or URL of the image on the back.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns this card.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the card was created.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the card was last modified.

textSize.description: Font size in pixels for the text overlay.

textColor.description: Hex or CSS color string for the text overlay.

verticalAlign.description: Vertical alignment of the text overlay.

interval.description: SM-2 spaced repetition interval in days.

nextReview.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds for next scheduled review.

/folders/{folderId}.description: A collection of folders for the nested hierarchy.
